{{Top}}
{{Youmay|use of the term ''senior officer'' in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military|senior military ranks such as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] and [[General/Legends|General]]}}
The title of '''senior officer''' was in use in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], apparently as a designation for the commanding officers of small, elite deployments, in forces such as the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] and [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. Though the term may also have been used in other contexts, it is here that it is best recorded.

Officers using this title included stormtrooper [[DSS-0956/Legends|DSS-0956]] (apparently a [[Captain/Legends|captain]]), who commanded the [[Desert Sands]] stormtrooper unit aboard [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']]; and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Vak Somoril]], who led the ISB [[tactical unit]] assigned aboard the Star Destroyer [[Reprisal (Imperial II-class)|''Reprisal'']] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].

In the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], upon promotion to a senior [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]], a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss officer/Legends|officer]] was stripped of family name and privilege and made part of the [[Defense Hierarchy]] in order that they may serve all Chiss without deference or prejudice.<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'' refers to the commander of the twenty-man stormtrooper detail on Tatooine as "Desert Sands senior officer DSS-0956" in the text and in the heading for his character template. In the ''dramatis personae'' list for [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']], [[Vak Somoril]], commanding an ISB unit of around a hundred men, is called "senior officer, Imperial Security Bureau", rather than by his rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]], where other characters are given specific titles like "captain", "general", "director of planning" and "Supreme Commander".
